label: Arrivals change in the forward cone
section: Arrivals change in the forward cone
subgoals: Identify the head of the changed arc
Collect every node reachable from it
Count those nodes as the ones whose arrivals must be re-evaluated

label: Required times change in the backward cone
section: Required times change in the backward cone
subgoals: Identify the tail of the changed arc
Collect every node that reaches it
Count those nodes as the ones whose required times must be re-evaluated

label: Slack changes in the union, lazily
section: Slack changes in the union, lazily
subgoals: Unite the forward cone of the head with the backward cone of the tail
Mark the affected values invalid instead of recomputing them
Recompute on query only the nodes the query needs, in level order
